comments.text:
I am from Norway. Its probably right that 90 % speak english. But its wrong to say 90% speak english fluent. Speaking a language fluen means that you can read and write and understand 100% just as good as your own native language. I speak english, but far from fluent. I speak better norwegian (since I am norwegian, and thats my native language). I find it very hard to imagine that 90 % of the people around me can speak and understand english just as good as they speak and understand norwegian

Ones in a while, but not often, I need too use google translate, and I hear friends and co-workers and family members saying that they are thankfull to modern technology, because now they don't need a paper dictionary if there are a few english words that they can not understand, now they can look it up on their phone

However. 90% in norway speak english pretty good is a more correct way to describe it 😀
